title: Searching for life on another planet
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What kind of evidence would scientists need before claiming they had found life beyond Earth?
Would discovering simple microbial life be as important as discovering intelligent life?
Should humanity actively send messages to possible extraterrestrial civilisations?
How would religion, philosophy, or politics react if life were confirmed on another planet?
Would you want to know if an advanced civilisation existed even if contacting it might carry risks?
